'''Flame [[Djinn]]''' are enslaved and used as power sources by the [[Stone Summit]] in [[Sorrow's Furnace]]. Three of them animate the [[Iron Forgeman]]. They can also be found in some of the warmer parts of the [[Depths of Tyria]].

==Locations==
*[[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]]
**[[Southern Shiverpeaks]]
***{{NPC location|Sorrow's Furnace}} (as a [[boss-like foe]]; only during [[Fire in the Hole]] and [[The Forge Heart]])
*[[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]]
**[[Depths of Tyria]]
***{{NPC location|Catacombs of Kathandrax}} (as a [[boss]]; on Level 3)

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|"To the Limit!"}}
*{{skill icon|Flourish}} ([[elite]])
*{{monster skill icon|Consuming Flames}}
*{{monster skill icon|Natural Resistance}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Pile of Elemental Dust]] (Eye of the North only)
*[[Pile of Glittering Dust]]

==Notes==
*[[Consuming Flames]] can be problematic unless the whole [[party]] tries to stick close to lessen the damage to each individual. If the party consists of predominantly ranged attackers, [[minion]]s will do in a pinch.
*This is a boss-like foe in Sorrow's Furnace, while it is a boss in Catacombs of Kathandrax.
*This has a [[miniature]] [[Miniature Flame Djinn|version]].
{{anomaly|In Catacombs of Kathandrax, it can [[drop]] an Elite Elementalist [[skill tome]], even though it has no Elementalist skills to [[Signet of Capture|capture]].}}
